offline: Awuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Okufakile kugcinwe kule foni futhi kuzovumelaniswa uma usuxhumekile.
beta: Ukuhumusha kusahlolwa — amanye amagama adinga ukubuyekezwa. Ungashintshela esiNgisini noma nini.
setup_uncertain: Faka okwaziyo. Ungakushintsha kamuva; imininingwane engekho yenza isilinganiso singaqiniseki.
after_costs: Ngemva kwezikweletu nezindleko okufanele zikhokhwe ngaphambi kwemali elandelayo oyilindele.
rough: Lesi isilinganiso esingaqondile. Faka izindleko ezivamile noma uqinisekise imali oyilindele ukuze sithuthuke.
empty: Qala ngokufaka imali onayo manje noma imali yakho yokuqala.
pattern: Ngokwalokho okufakile futhi kwaqinisekiswa: {pattern}. Kulungile lokhu?
no_shortfall: Akubikezelwa ukuphela kwemali ezinsukwini ezingu-14 ezizayo.
confirm_income: Qinisekisa noma ushintshe le mali elindelekile.
confirm_cost: Qinisekisa noma ushintshe le ndleko ehleliwe.
uncertain: Asikwazi ukuqiniseka. Qaphela futhi uqinisekise ngenombolo esemthethweni ozitholele yona.
safe_step: Ungabelani nge-PIN noma ngekhodi yesikhathi esisodwa. Ungakhokhi imali ukuze uvule imali. Xhumana nenhlangano ngenombolo ozitholele yona.
privacy: Susa ama-PIN, amakhodi nemininingwane ye-akhawunti ngaphambi kokuhlola.
missing_terms: Eminye imigomo ayikho. Yifake ngaphambi kokuqhathanisa.
above_limit: Lokhu kungaphezu komkhawulo osemthethweni wohlobo olukhethiwe lwemalimboleko.
loan_disclaimer: Lesi sibali siqhathanisa izinombolo ozifakile. Asikuncomi ukuthi uboleke.
stokvel_daily: Beka eceleni cishe u-{amount} ngosuku kuze kube yileso sikhathi.
taxi_example: Itekisi lokuya emsebenzini izinsuku ezingu-{days} = {amount} kuleli sonto.
unknown_fare: Asinayo intengo eqinisekisiwe yale ndlela. Faka inani ovame ukulikhokha.
